question: In a certain code language, 'NORMAL' is written as 'LMPOCN' and 'PEOPLE' is written as 'NCMRNG'. How will 'MOMENT' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

'NORMAL' is written as 'LMPOCN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/479d01166167abbb2aacf2d332e59acfc1ca99be9158e80f79e3f456289da3b2.png] 

And,

'PEOPLE' is written as 'NCMRNG'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16ea498e97fef4f26f04f4cad4a8b227ee67694088d8d883998ce88a0972afcb.png] 

Similarly,

'MOMENT' will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29b00bcf449bf9ea9d5d76af8618dd890729bc681d24864dcb00b4634f6c565c.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
